severity_name: HEAVY SLOP WARNING — SYNTHETIC WILDLIFE ADVISORY
headline: HEAVY SLOP WARNING: FABRICATED-CRITTER FRONT SWEEPS FIVE REGIONS AS ENDLESS SYNTHETIC 'CAUGHT ON CAMERA' CLIPS DEPOSIT RABBITS BOUNCING ON TRAMPOLINES, KITTENS RESCUED FROM IMPOSSIBLE PERIL, AND BABY ANIMALS PERFORMING FEATS NO VETERINARIAN HAS EVER SIGNED OFF ON
advisory: A slow-churning system of adorable fabrication has settled over the short-form regions, generating heartwarming animal footage at a rate no ecosystem could sustain. Residents are advised that the trampoline is not real, the rabbits are not real, and the security-camera timestamp in the corner was rendered by the same process as the rabbits. The Service reminds the public that genuine cuteness does occur in nature but rarely at 30 clips per hour from an account with no bio. Emotional responses remain valid; the footage does not.

regional_outlook.conditions: Dense vertical fog of looping animal miracles, each capped at eleven seconds. Visibility good, authenticity nil; the same kitten is being rescued in four different states simultaneously.
Warm sentimental air mass parked overhead, driving heavy 'so sweet 🥰' comment accumulation on wildlife that does not exist. Residents over a certain trust threshold advised to hydrate and log off.
Scattered outbreaks of 'nature is healing' beneath videos where nature is, in fact, a diffusion model. Community-note precipitation intermittent and arriving late.
Still-frame drift as trampoline-rabbit content settles into 'backyard inspo' boards. Expect residents planning real trampolines for imaginary rabbits.
Query 'is the bunny trampoline video real' now returns eight articles, six of which were generated to answer it and none of which know.

specimen.status: Overwhelmingly abundant; breeds fastest wherever a monetized loop is possible.
specimen.habitat: Autoplay feeds, 'satisfying animals' compilations, and the quiet hours between 11 p.m. and sleep, when critical faculties are lowest and the thumb is heaviest.
specimen.field_marks: Impossibly consistent lighting; fur that flickers at the edges; a physics of bouncing that belongs to no known gravity. Watch the paws — synthetic animals frequently grow or shed a toe between frames.
specimen.call: You won't BELIEVE what this rescued kitten did next — watch till the end! 🐱💕
specimen.confusion_species: Easily mistaken for a genuine backyard-camera clip, which is the point. Tell them apart by counting the legs across three seconds and asking who, exactly, was filming the rabbit at that flattering angle at 6 a.m.

spotter_tip: If a wild animal is performing a coordinated stunt directly into the camera with perfect framing and a swelling music cue, you are not watching wildlife — you are watching a business model with ears.
tomorrow: Cuteness-saturated fronts persist; expect synthetic puppies to breach the Inbox Estuary via forwarded family newsletters.

confirmed_sighting.report: The Service notes for the record that 'AI slop' was named the 2025 Word of the Year by both Merriam-Webster and Australia's Macquarie Dictionary, and that AI-generated articles now reportedly make up more than half of all English-language web content per SEO firm Graphite. When the phenomenon you monitor becomes a dictionary headline, the forecast is no longer speculative.
